cat > /workspace/tmp/bench2.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *
from planning import solve
from common import validate
import networkx as nx

def build(nreq,noff,per,seed=3):
    random.seed(seed)
    leases=[{'id':'L0','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','start':0,'end':10**12,'subnets':[0],'low_count':32}]
    services=[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}]
    rq=[{'id':'all','parent':None,'capacity':4096}]
    oq=[{'id':'all','parent':None,'capacity':4096}]
    requests=[{'id':'q%05d'%i,'at':10,'lease':'L0','target':'2001:db8:1:1200::%d'%(i+1),
               'service':'web','group':'all'} for i in range(nreq)]
    offers=[]
    for j in range(noff):
        reqs=random.sample([r['id'] for r in requests],min(per,nreq))
        offers.append({'id':'p%05d'%j,'time':20,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64',
                       'capacity':2,'cost':random.randint(0,10**9),'group':'all','requests':reqs})
    return base_job(leases=leases,services=services,queries=[10],requests=requests,offers=offers,
             request_quotas=rq,offer_quotas=oq)

def nx_graph(context,active):
    requests=context['requests']; offers=context['offers']
    G=nx.DiGraph()
    rq=context['request_quotas']; oq=context['offer_quotas']
    for nid,node in oq.items():
        if node['parent'] is None: G.add_edge('S',('O',nid),capacity=node['capacity'],weight=0)
        else: G.add_edge(('O',node['parent']),('O',nid),capacity=node['capacity'],weight=0)
    for oid,offer in offers.items():
        G.add_edge(('O',offer['group']),('P',oid),capacity=offer['capacity'],weight=0)
    for nid,node in rq.items():
        if node['parent'] is None: G.add_edge(('R',nid),'T',capacity=node['capacity'],weight=0)
        else: G.add_edge(('R',nid),('R',node['parent']),capacity=node['capacity'],weight=0)
    for rid,request in requests.items():
        if not active.get(rid): continue
        G.add_edge(('Q',rid),('R',request['group']),capacity=1,weight=0)
    for oid,offer in offers.items():
        for rid in offer['requests']:
            if not active.get(rid): continue
            request=requests[rid]
            if offer['service']!=request['service']: continue
            if request['at']>offer['time']: continue
            if offer['time']>=context['leases'][request['lease']]['end']: continue
            net=offer['network']
            if not int(net.network_address)<=request['address']<=int(net.broadcast_address): continue
            G.add_edge(('P',oid),('Q',rid),capacity=1,weight=offer['cost'])
    return G

for nreq,noff,per in ((256,512,32),(1024,2048,32)):
    job=build(nreq,noff,per)
    context=validate(job)
    active={r['id']:True for r in context['requests'].values()}
    t=time.time(); plan=solve(context,active); mine=time.time()-t
    G=nx_graph(context,active)
    t=time.time()
    flow=nx.max_flow_min_cost(G,'S','T')
    value=nx.maximum_flow_value(G,'S','T'); cost=nx.cost_of_flow(G,flow)
    nxt=time.time()-t
    print('nreq=%d noff=%d mine=(%d,%d) in %.2fs  nx=(%d,%d) in %.2fs'%(nreq,noff,plan['resolved'],plan['cost'],mine,value,cost,nxt))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && timeout 600 python3 /workspace/tmp/bench2.py
